title: Bromus texensis FNA lemma apex and photo target consistency
reason: Correct a diagnostic false-positive in the existing Texas brome teaching text: FNA describes entire acute/subulate lemma apices with 4–8 mm straight awns, not a mandatory two-toothed tip with a 6–10 mm awn. Align species crew copy, visible first-photo lesson, two macro-photography targets, and caution against trusting apparent teeth in low-resolution photos.
